source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 22:30 binds Hebrew 23:1; public 23:1–25 binds Hebrew 23:2–26. All other verses in chapters 19–26 align directly. All 179 original XML records, including written/read and numbering notes, are hashed in full.

key_decisions.decision: Names both bodily injuries without a vague euphemism; keeps assembly without claiming its disputed exact membership scope.
Selects forbidden union for the uncertain mamzer category, qualified in the note; retains tenth generation and repeated assembly phrase.
Preserves both named peoples, tenth generation, and enduring exclusion without harmonizing later texts.
Preserves both peace and welfare as objects of the enduring prohibition rather than softening it to military caution.
Makes the night-occurrence euphemism readable while retaining ritual uncleanness rather than moral blame.
Preserves the unqualified wording of the non-return command without inserting an unstated nationality limitation.
Keeps the escaped slave's choice of residence and the explicit non-oppression command.
Preserves female and male qedeshah/qadesh with the traditional rendering; notes the uncertainty of the roles rather than inventing ritual details.
Retains the literal dog term and separate payment nouns, with the possible male-prostitute interpretation in the apparatus.
Retains the explicit distinction between foreigner and fellow Israelite and the land blessing.
